blocks.named_stop: NOT APPLICABLE TO THIS REPO. Porch & Party publishes event-decor and porch-styling answers for Memphis homeowners; there is no prompt for a reader to copy, and emitting one on 109 decor pages would be scaffolding of exactly the kind the template-share ceiling and the fabricated-content rules exist to prevent. Retired by flag rather than deleted: the block stays in the spec and the detector stays live, so the day this repo does publish a copyable prompt the flag below fails and the entry is reinstated. Reinstate by setting applies_to_repo true and adding an emitter to templates/page-shell.js.
